🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation (10/11 sectors) vs. tech megacap weakness (MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%)) create mixed signals; leadership concentrated in Industrials (Leadership: Concentrated — 3/5 Industrials in Top 5) supports a neutral read.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Industrials lead: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%). Communication showing strength: T ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.46%). Energy solid: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%). Consumer Discretionary mixed with dispersion: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) vs TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%). Real Estate shows pockets of weakness: CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -9.75%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Industrials) — cyclicals driving the move.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -1.91%), UBER BELOW TREND (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -5.63%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -9.75%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%). Weakness concentrated in select tech and real-estate names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: GM (1W: +14.42%), LMT (1W: +13.83%), RTX (1W: +12.33%). Major divergence present — multiple megacaps in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA CORRECTION, GOOGL BELOW TREND) — this is a MAJOR Divergence; treat as tactical, not a broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and corrective: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%) contrasts with MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%), META CORRECTION (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%). Sector breadth: Technology is the sole laggard (1W: -1.32% | 24 stocks); dispersion between leaders and large-cap weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and broadly ABOVE TREND: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +11.78%). Sector breadth: Financials positive (1W: +0.54% | 20 stocks); supports cyclical/value tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Stable with leadership: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +6.05%); UNH in CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%). Sector breadth: Healthcare positive (1W: +2.13% | 17 stocks).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and selected Financials and Industrials given concentrated leadership (GM, LMT, RTX, JPM ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to large-cap tech names in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (GOOGL BELOW TREND, NVDA CORRECTION, META CORRECTION). Monitor AAPL ABOVE TREND as a potential stable growth exposure amid the divergence.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%). BEARISH: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +4.45% | broad leadership concentrated in defence and industrials). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.32% | 24 stocks) — monitor megacap flow and sentiment.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: failure to reclaim 1M momentum would extend CORRECTION; watch reclaim above recent 1M pivot for stabilization. AAPL: hold 1M uptrend to keep ABOVE TREND continuation. JPM: uptick above recent 1W breakout to confirm Financials strength. TSLA: breach below recent 1W low would deepen BELOW TREND risk.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
VZ (+75): Verizon raises 2026 outlook; VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.46%) — sentiment confirmed by price. KO (+80): Coca‑Cola beats Q2 and raises guide; KO (price data not shown in detail here) — news indicates confirmed fundamental support, watch price action for follow-through. UPS (+85): Q2 beat and raised outlook; UPS (price data not shown here) — catalyst supportive for industrial/logistics exposure.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-50): circular-financing headlines; NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) — sentiment confirms recent weakness and adds downside risk. BA (-55): larger-than-expected Q2 loss; BA RECOVERY (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -3.04%) — news remains a drag despite small 1W bounce (divergence). TSLA (-45): weak headlines amid sector volatility; TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) — sentiment confirmed by price.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style favored given concentrated Industrials/Financials leadership. GM, LMT, RTX ABOVE TREND while megacap techs show CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (AAPL exception). Key risk: MAJOR divergence among megacaps (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) and negative sentiment on NVDA may widen dispersion — monitor for trend breaks.
